verdict.rationale: n8n's canvas-based execution tracing is referenced in marketing docs ('Every step of your agents' reasoning, traceable on the canvas') and independently corroborated by a hands-on user noting it keeps historical executions so you can see data going in/out of each node when debugging. However, there is no explicit documentation or mention of the 'pin data' / sample-data testing feature described in the story, and no walkthrough of pre-production testing workflow. Missing for 10: explicit docs on pinning sample data for test runs, and a clear developer workflow showing pre-go-live inspection rather than just post-hoc execution history.
